summary: Rewrote upload_file in archive/hollin.py for Hollin v3 and the upload client standard: plan-based chunk size (pro treated as team), parts numbered from 1, Part-Checksum sha256 base64, file checksum as unpadded base64url of the digest-of-digests plus -count, resume with a received-parts check, parts_missing retry, and one replacement session on 410. Checked against a fake server and the existing unit test; one judgement call: the file checksum uses the changelog's base64url encoding, because the checksums page still shows the older hex form.
